name: severe combined immunodeficiency due to DCLRE1C deficiency
description: Severe combined immunodeficiency (SCID) due to DCLRE1C deficiency is a type of SCID characterized by severe and recurrent infections, diarrhea, failure to thrive, and cell sensitivity to ionizing radiation.
